objective: Test a distinct execution-grounded evidence channel for source discrimination after static acquisition and matched reader failures.
research_relation: SBEST motivates combining runtime test coverage with stack information when failure-localization evidence is sparse. This pilot is not its algorithm reproduction and does not transfer its published performance. Native Defects4J supports single-test Cobertura analysis with explicit instrumentation classes.
case: Already exposed JxPath-8; selected for existing canonical fixture/trigger reproduction, not an unseen confirmation or a quality sample.
instrumentation: All top-level types in every src/java production source, with pinned framework inner-class inclusion. Explicit -i argument mandatory. Default fix-modified-class instrumentation is forbidden as answer leakage.
data_boundary: Pinned trusted framework construction may internally consume fixture metadata/patches, as in the existing canonical adapter. Candidate analysis receives only exact buggy Java projection and execution coverage. No fixed-source contents, modified-class lists, reference labels or unopened cases enter the candidate.
isolation: New exclusive WSL archive root; network-disabled bwrap and cleared environment; host home/mnt/run hidden except exact pinned framework/toolchain and new output. Old fixtures and receipts unchanged. No fallback or retries.
comparability: Runtime evidence changes the input task. Any later comparison must supply identical coverage, source and query data to all matched comparators and account for test execution cost. It cannot be compared unfairly against historical source-only scores.

construction_boundary.authority: Standing private G01/G02/G03 benchmark research approval; D65 candidate only
construction_boundary.product_frontier: Source-derived all-class instrumentation and isolated coverage adapter
construction_boundary.runnable_product_work: One pinned exposed fixture and triggering test

claim_ceiling: One-case feasibility, not ranking accuracy, SBEST reproduction or superiority. Existing failed gates remain unchanged.

terminal_evidence.interpretation: The channel works offline on one exposed fixture. Two positive class-line entries duplicate source-line coordinates, so unique covered source units are933, not935. Execution is not proof of responsibility.

open_questions: Can the pinned permanent toolchain produce all-production coverage offline without touching old evidence?
Can executed lines be bound exactly to canonical buggy sources?
Does execution evidence distinguish relevant production files beyond strong matched inputs, rather than just add runtime cost?
